scientific_question: What native MCES quality is reached by RASCAL and the training-free EMA anytime solver as a function of end-to-end wall-clock budget?
time_definition: End-to-end per-pair elapsed wall time from pair loading and ACG construction through the incumbent available at each deadline.

ema_contract.immediate_incumbent: canonical injective mapping immediately after ACG construction, followed by Hungarian rounding of fixed structural initializer logits before Sinkhorn/mirror processing
ema_contract.continuous_stream_policy: one deterministic fixed/fixed/unit trajectory followed by short anytime hard-search atoms
ema_contract.candidate_selection: best directly observed legal hard MCES score
ema_contract.anytime_requirement: Every deadline has a legal incumbent and every later checkpoint retains every earlier incumbent.

reporting.primary: mean native edge accuracy versus declared wall-clock deadline
reporting.secondary: exact-reference recovery, mean edge deficit, timeouts, and paired bootstrap intervals

supersedes.reason: The v1 implementation constructed four continuous streams before its first hard incumbent; its first four AIDS records had no incumbent at 15 seconds, violating the declared anytime checkpoint contract.
